summary_en: Tender offer period extended to 2026-07-16 (total 47 business days). Minimum tender threshold 34,941,000 shares (17.51% of S/O). No upper limit; offeror (Kamgras 1 Corp, EQT-backed) intends to acquire all shares, making Kakaku.com non-public. Extension rationale: provide shareholders and warrant holders further decision opportunity; elevate odds of offer success.
summary_jp: 買付期間を2026年7月16日まで延長（合計47営業日）。最低買付数34,941,000株（発行済の17.51%）。上限なし；買付者（EQT傘下のKamgras１株式会社）が全株式取得し非公開化を企図。延長理由：株主らに応募機会提供、買付成立可能性向上。

Tender price and other material terms unchanged from prior May 12, 2026 announcement. Delisting intended upon completion.
